key_idea: Constructing a structural graph counterexample by defining a triangle-free relation on a high-dimensional tensor space and applying Fourier estimates and weak product testing.
reason: The core idea of recasting a structural graph theory problem into the probabilistic and Fourier analytic language of product testing is highly surprising and crosses field boundaries. However, this conceptual skeleton is buried under a massive, densely intricate technical apparatus of mixed-law estimates and parameter hierarchies that makes it difficult to survey.
